script.speaker: brooke
script.text: market night, take two! who's coming?

script.speaker: mina
script.text: me! i've heard about this market all week and still haven't seen it :)

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: I'm in. First visit for me as well. I've printed a map. Of a market. I'm aware.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: cyrus. there are no street names. it's smoke and fairy lights. you follow your nose

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: My nose doesn't come with a legend. The map stays.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: ok so. last time we walked past a whole row of viet stalls on the way to the tacos and i've thought about it every day since

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: i'm in. and mina, cyrus: you're coming in the front way with me. the first look is the best part

script.speaker: mina
script.text: is it as pretty at night as everyone says? i'm a little nervous i'll stop at every stall and never pick one

script.speaker: liam
script.text: that's exactly how you do it. i've stopped at every stall and i still haven't found my noodle stall

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: cyrus, heads up: a lot of those viet stalls had a big tub of crushed peanuts on the counter. we're skipping every one of those for you

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Appreciated. The map is getting a legend after all.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: oh, and mina, half that row does tofu versions of everything. i only noticed because i was hunting for the biggest bowl

script.speaker: mina
script.text: tofu everything?? that sounds like my kind of row :)

script.speaker: mina
script.text: cyrus, save me a corner of that map. i want to doodle the stalls i like

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: also: it's way too warm tonight for anything heavy. i want food that feels like a breeze, not a blanket

script.speaker: liam
script.text: so the stalls with the giant bubbling fryers are out for you

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: I've circled the viet row. Mina, the margins are yours. Assistant, the rest is up to you.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: pick us a winner. i'm already walking
